extraction.notes: Reconciliation starts from Net income and runs to FFO available to Common Shares and Units (NAREIT FFO, 301,116), then to Normalized FFO available to Common Shares and Units (300,566). Preferred distributions (772) sit between the starting line and the FFO subtotal, so they are included in ffo_adjustments; that is how the printed lines sum to 301,116. The company's Normalized FFO line is labeled 'Normalized FFO' (301,338) before preferred distributions; the Normalized FFO available to Common Shares and Units (300,566) is used as core_total. No AFFO metric is reported, so affo fields are null. Recurring capex is not set because there is no AFFO section; the Capital Expenditures to Real Estate table (page 23, quarter, company total 35,285) mixes building improvements, renovations and replacements, so I did not extract a recurring-only figure. Category 'other' was used for preferred distributions, non-operating impairment (zero), non-operating asset (gains) losses and other miscellaneous items, since none fit the listed categories cleanly. Diluted shares 389,628 checks: 301,116/389,628 = 0.77 and 300,566/389,628 = 0.77.
